title: Learning-to-Optimize as the Missing Architectural Layer of AI-Native Networks
abstract: arXiv:2609.21519v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is becoming a fundamental design principle of future AI-native communication networks, enabling autonomous resource management, adaptive control, and zero-touch network operation. While current AI-native architectures increasingly embed intelligence across network functions, they provide little guidance on how optimisation knowledge should be systematically generated, transferred, and exploited by AI models. This paper argues that the Learning-to-Optimize (L2O) represents the missing architectural layer between optimisation and AI-native intelligence. Rather than viewing optimisation merely as an online decision engine, the proposed paradigm redefines optimisation algorithms as offline knowledge generators that produce high-quality supervisory information for neural surrogate models. The resulting models inherit optimisation expertise while enabling low-latency runtime inference suitable for dynamic network e

translated_title: 学习优化作为AI原生网络缺失的架构层
translated_abstract: 人工智能（AI）正在成为未来AI原生通信网络的基本设计原则，实现自主资源管理、自适应控制和零接触网络运营。尽管当前的AI原生架构日益将智能嵌入到各个网络功能中，但对于优化知识应如何被AI模型系统地生成、迁移和利用，它们几乎没有提供指导。本文认为，学习优化（Learning-to-Optimize, L2O）代表了优化与AI原生智能之间缺失的架构层。所提出的范式不再仅仅将优化视为在线决策引擎，而是重新定义优化算法为离线知识生成器，为神经代理模型产生高质量的监督信息。由此产生的模型继承了优化专业知识，同时支持适用于动态网络环境的低延迟运行时推理。
tldr: 本文提出将学习优化（L2O）作为AI原生网络中缺失的架构层，重新定义优化算法为离线知识生成器，为神经代理模型提供高质量监督信息，使模型在继承优化专业知识的同时实现适合动态网络环境的低延迟推理。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Learning-to-Optimize (L2O) as the missing architectural layer of AI-native networks, redefining optimization algorithms as offline knowledge generators that produce high-quality supervisory information for neural surrogate models, enabling low-latency inference while inheriting optimization expertise.
